mapper.sql: id, club_id, target_member_id, role_code, scope_type, scope_id, status, expires_at, assigned_by_member_id, assigned_at, revoked_by_member_id, revoked_at, revoke_reason, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: select from club_role_assignment where club_id = #{clubId} and target_member_id = #{memberId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and (expires_at is null or expires_at > #{now}) and ( (scope_type = 'CLUB' and scope_id = club_id) or (#{activityId} is not null and scope_type = 'EVENT' and scope_id = #{activityId}) ) order by case when scope_type = 'CLUB' then 0 else 1 end, id asc

select cra.id, cra.club_id, cra.target_member_id, cra.role_code, cra.scope_type, cra.scope_id, cra.status, cra.expires_at, cra.assigned_by_member_id, cra.assigned_at, cra.revoked_by_member_id, cra.revoked_at, cra.revoke_reason, cra.version, cra.create_by, cra.create_time, cra.update_by, cra.update_time, ca.topic_id as scope_topic_id from club_role_assignment cra inner join cms_activity ca on ca.id = cra.scope_id and ca.club_id = cra.club_id and ca.del_flag = 0 where cra.club_id = #{clubId} and cra.target_member_id = #{memberId} and cra.scope_type = 'EVENT' and cra.role_code in ('EVENT_LEAD', 'EVENT_CHECKIN') and cra.status = 'ACTIVE' and (cra.expires_at is null or cra.expires_at > #{now}) order by cra.scope_id asc, cra.id asc
select from club_role_assignment where id = #{id} for update
select from club_role_assignment where club_id = #{clubId} and role_code = 'EVENT_LEAD' and scope_type = 'EVENT' and scope_id = #{activityId} and status = 'ACTIVE' order by id asc for update
mapper.insert: insert into club_role_assignment (club_id, target_member_id, role_code, scope_type, scope_id, status, expires_at, assigned_by_member_id, assigned_at, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{clubId}, #{targetMemberId}, #{roleCode}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{assignedByMemberId}, #{assignedAt}, #{version}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
